Confirmed. The sparse-round replay bug is coupled: `load_checkpoint()` reconstructs `RoundRecord`s by enumerating `all_findings`, while `compute_metrics()` writes metrics back by list position (`self.state.round_records[round_idx]`). If round indices are sparse or mismatched, fixing only one side still corrupts identity. I am not re-filing that pair unless I can prove a residual path remains after the shared fix set.
